All linter rules

  1. Tools chevron_right
  2. Linter rules chevron_right
  3. All linter rules

The following is an auto-generated list of all linter rules available in the Dart SDK as of version 3.7.1. Add them to your analysis_options.yaml file and adjust as you see fit.

analysis_options.yaml
yaml
linter:
  rules:
    - always_declare_return_types
    - always_put_control_body_on_new_line
    - always_put_required_named_parameters_first

    - always_use_package_imports
    - annotate_overrides
    - annotate_redeclares
    - avoid_annotating_with_dynamic
    - avoid_bool_literals_in_conditional_expressions

    - avoid_catching_errors

    - avoid_empty_else
    - avoid_equals_and_hash_code_on_mutable_classes
    - avoid_escaping_inner_quotes
    - avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes
